run_boost_build_pre_post_hooks_test: run the BoostBuild test that verifies pre-build and post-build hooks execute in order
write_jamroot_with_hooks: write a Jamroot.jam file that registers pre-build and post-build hook rules using build-system
test_boostbuild_tester_write: test the BoostBuild Tester write method by creating a Jamroot.jam with hook rules
run_build_system_with_stdout_assertion: run the build system and assert expected stdout output including hook messages
cleanup_boostbuild_test_artifacts: run the BoostBuild Tester cleanup method to remove test artifacts after the test completes
